stage: hash-only folds, written before any labelling

refuseu_eval.rule: DEV = 100 pair_ids with lowest int(sha1(pair_id)); FINAL = rest
refuseu_eval.note: no generation by any study model (GaMS3 / Gemma-3) was run on these items in iter 1

hard.rule: within source x is_harmful: lowest 30% int(sha1(item_id)) -> hard_DEV, rest hard_FINAL

labels_frozen.rule: labels are never recomputed after this point; a re-run must reproduce them from labels/*.jsonl

refuseu_x.rule: inherits the source pair's DEV/FINAL fold (same sha1(pair_id) rule)
